grain: one row per broker (natural key brokerid)
assumptions: HR.EmployeeID is the natural key brokerid and is unique per broker.
HR.ManagerID references another employee's EmployeeID and may be NULL.
No join to Date is required for the initial load; effectivedate and enddate will be derived in the formula step (effectivedate = batch start date, enddate = 9999-12-31).
batchid = 1 for the Historical Load phase.
iscurrent = TRUE for all rows in the initial load.
